auth_headline_default:
Jot down what you spent.
Know where it went.
auth_headline_create:
All your money,
wherever it lives.
auth_subline_default: Bank accounts, cash, cards and investments, in any currency, kept in one place.
auth_subline_demo: Quick entry on your phone. The full picture on your desktop.
auth_subline_create: A salary account in Berlin, savings in Mumbai, a card in dollars, cash in the drawer. Kosha keeps them together.
auth_step_accounts: Add your accounts, in any currency
auth_step_log: Log spending in a few taps on your phone
auth_step_see: See where it went on your desktop
auth_login_description: Sign in to Kosha, or create a free account.
auth_google_not_linked: That email already has a Kosha account. Sign in with your password or passkey, then connect Google in Settings › Sign-in & security.
auth_google_failed: Signing in with Google didn't work. Try again.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth_error_wrong_password: Wrong email or password. Try again, or use a passkey.
auth_error_invalid_email: Enter a full email address, like you@example.com.
auth_error_email_taken: That email already has a Kosha account. Sign in instead.
auth_error_passkey: That passkey didn't work. Try again, or use your password.
auth_error_offline: Kosha couldn't be reached. Check your connection, then try again.
auth_password_changed_body: Sign in with your new password.
auth_demo_lead: A shared account with 14 months of sample data.
auth_create_lead: Start with your email. You'll add accounts next.
auth_demo_note: You can open everything. Adding, editing and deleting are turned off, so the next person sees it as you did.
auth_agree: By creating an account you agree to the {#terms}terms{/terms} and {#privacy}privacy policy{/privacy}.
auth_demo_own_account: Have an account? {#link}Sign in to your own{/link}
auth_2fa_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth_2fa_timed_out: This sign-in timed out. Go back and sign in again.
auth_2fa_bad_code: That code didn't work. Try again.
auth_2fa_backup_lead: Enter one of the backup codes you saved. Each works once.
auth_2fa_lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth_2fa_lead_for: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for {#strong}{email}{/strong}.
auth_2fa_paste_hint: Pasting the whole code works too.
auth_2fa_phone_hint: Your phone may offer the code above the keyboard.
auth_2fa_trust_browser: Kosha won't ask for a code on this browser until then.
auth_2fa_trust_phone: Kosha won't ask for a code on this phone until then.
auth_2fa_no_access: No access to your authenticator app? Each backup code you saved works once.
auth_2fa_back_to_code: Back to the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth_reset_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth_expired_body: Reset links work once, for one hour. Your password hasn't changed. Ask for a new link and use the newest email.
auth_reset_body: Enter the email you use for Kosha. We'll send a link to set a new password.
auth_passkey_failed: That passkey didn't work. Try again, or reset your password.
auth_passkey_offer_device: Have a passkey on this device?
auth_passkey_offer_phone: Have a passkey on this phone?
auth_passkey_offer_body: Sign in with it instead. No password needed.
auth_check_email_body: If {#strong}{email}{/strong} has a Kosha account, a link to reset its password is on its way. The link works for one hour.
auth_check_step_open: Open the email from Kosha with the subject {#b}{subject}{/b}.
auth_check_step_choose: Choose {#b}{button}{/b}. It opens Kosha in this browser or any other.
auth_check_spam: Nothing after a minute? Look in spam, then send it again.
auth_reset_signs_out: Saving signs Kosha out on your other devices. Passkeys and two-factor stay as they are.
auth_consent_failed_body: This sign-in request has expired or was changed. Start again from the app.
auth_consent_error: Something went wrong. Try again from the app.
auth_consent_local_title: This app runs on this computer.
auth_consent_local_body: Allow it only if you just started it, for example in a terminal.
auth_consent_scope_read: See your accounts, transactions, categories, recurring payments and reports
auth_consent_write_off: Off. This app will connect read-only.
auth_consent_disconnect: You can disconnect it any time in Settings › API & MCP.
email_reset_preview: The link works once, for one hour.
email_reset_body: Someone asked to reset the password for the Kosha account {#strong}{email}{/strong}. If that was you, set a new one below. The link works once, for one hour.
email_reset_paste: Or paste this link into your browser:
email_reset_not_you: {#strong}Didn't ask for this?{/strong} Ignore this email. Your password stays the same, and nobody can change it without this link.
email_reset_footer: You're getting this because a password reset was asked for on your account.
